properties.summary: Extend the agentic corpus beyond text-and-code: multimodal chunk markers, per-language AST depth through the LSP substrate, first-class file entities, cross-reference edge resolution, and a learned rerank stage.

Close the gaps between the provenance design and what the runtime records: historical backfill of tool-call edges, arc-produced-commit wiring, git-notes sync automation, and a generic anchor-indexed lookup.
Turn designed evaluation into standing gates: audit example sets in CI, the remaining probe-team question shapes, live proof of the pathology ensemble family, and richer per-class checker semantics.
Finish deferred plumbing in the deterministic orchestration pipelines: ensemble output boundaries, multi-partition compaction per tick, and source-query propagation into auto-digest.
Structural fixes the substrate keeps working around: a per-turn tool call budget for agentic actors, and explicit vector-store passing in place of the module-level singleton.
Once the Layer 0 routing substrate and the multimodal provider land, which of the seven deferred X-* formats ship first, and does each need its own compatibility family?
